note: PATCH /conversations/{id}: rename, archive, unarchive, link an uncampaigned conversation to a campaign, bind the channel. At least one key; none is nullable, because moving a conversation between campaigns or unlinking it is not in v1. A repeat is a no-op, so no key is needed.

invalid.name: nothing to change
invalid.why: a patch names at least one of title, archived, campaign_id and started_mode

invalid.name: unlinking with a null campaign
invalid.why: requirement 6: moving or unlinking is not in v1, so campaign_id is not nullable

invalid.name: clearing the title with null
invalid.why: no key of a patch is nullable

invalid.name: a null archive flag
invalid.why: no key of a patch is nullable

invalid.name: a title that trims to nothing
invalid.why: ruling A2-9: 1 to 200 characters after trimming

invalid.name: a tab inside a title
invalid.why: ruling A2-9: U+0000 to U+001F are refused inside a title; only its edges are trimmed

invalid.name: a moment instead of the archive flag
invalid.why: the server sets archived_at; a request is strict

invalid.name: the owner in a request
invalid.why: the owner is the session; a request is strict
